statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ shows two-way overnight trade, not persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The main conditional risk window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the U.S. open, Flash PMI, Fed and EIA.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress; open/PMI is the narrow conditional danger window.
body: Delayed December NQ is near 31,031 inside a 30,983-31,071 range, only modestly above its 31,009 open. Reuters reports Nasdaq futures fractionally firmer and oil lower. Finviz context is marginally stale and partial, so it is excluded from current scoring.

lookbackSummary: Prior 24-hour Tail was mostly low, briefly reaching 27% around the prior U.S. open before returning to low; Stress stayed high to extreme.
outlookSummary: Base-case Tail stays low outside the 13:30-15:30 UTC open/PMI/Fed/EIA cluster; escalation requires persistent direction and weak retracements.

drivers: Two-way delayed NQ range; no persistent extension
